question: Which of the following dances is performed by monks and Lamas in monastery to ward off evils and spirits?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cham**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cham Mask dance is a sacred dance ritual celebrated in Bhutan.

 
 
• The dance is performed by monks and laymen wearing masks and costumes.
 
• It is an essential part of the religious festivals known as Tsechus, which are held in various monasteries and dzongs across Bhutan.
 
• The dance is believed to bring blessings to onlookers and establish a connection with the spiritual world.
 
• Cham dances often depict stories and legends from Buddhist texts and are accompanied by traditional music.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Kullu Nati **

 
 
• Kullu Nati Dance: Nati is the most famous folk dance in Himachal Pradesh. In the Guinness world record book, it is listed as the largest folk dance.
 
• Jhora, Jhali, Chharhi, Dhaman, Chhapeli, and Mahasu are the folk dance of Himachal Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Hikat** 
 
 
• Hikat is danced by forming pairs, extending their arms and with the body inclined, they go round and round at the same position.
 
• This dance is filled with joy and is associated with Jammu and Kashmir. 
 
• This dance is performed by everyone to welcome the spring season in Kashmir and celebrates the harvesting season.
 
• When the dance originated, there were no instruments or music, people hold their wrists and just sing and spin. As the dance progress, it speeds up and beats become faster.
 
 
• But nowadays, you will hear and feel the music and the sound of Rabab, drums accompanying the folk dance.
 
 
 
• Damali, Rauf and Mandjas are the other folk dances from Jammu and Kashmir.
 
 
 
• **Rauf**
 
 
• Rauf is a traditional folk dance of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It is performed mainly by women during the spring season and on various festive occasions.
 
• The dance is characterized by its rhythmic movements and is often accompanied by folk songs.
 
• Rauf is an integral part of the cultural heritage of Jammu and Kashmir and reflects the region's rich traditions and customs.
